name: Kayla Leech
source: Frehsman Kayla is a student at Crowhive House. At first glance she may seem like a sweet girl, but her hobbies are far from ordinary - she's into martial arts. Kayla aspires to master the art of magical combat, but admits that she's not an expert yet. Although she tries to look strong and indipendent, I get the feeling that it's just a way to hide her vulnerable side.
